title: ‘NAZA,’ Israeli Film About Killings in Gaza, Faces Backlash
summary_full: The film “NAZA” investigates the killing of Palestinians by Israeli forces in Gaza. Israel’s culture minister has suggested revoking the directors’ citizenship.
